what: Every call of the gated delta rule the library and its callers make, by its dimensions; each cell is a certification cell of `ops.gated_delta_rule.gated_delta_rule_path`. A call of ONE token runs the serial scan whatever the cell (the token step). A longer call runs the chunked form when its cell's `chunked_from_length` is a length and the call is at least that long, the serial scan otherwise; `chunked_from_length` null means the chunked form is not certified for the cell (the serial scan, the measured path, runs). A call whose dimensions are in no cell is refused by name. A cell is certified only by `tools/measure_the_chunked_gated_delta_rule.py` on a named card: its `proof` then names the card, the commit, the date and the result file, and `chunked_from_length` the shortest measured length from which the chunked form is exact and faster than the serial scan at every longer measured length.

callers.caller: nbxtensor: any other op of the library
callers.dimensions: none: no op of the library calls the gated delta rule
none yet: the engine's sources carry no call of the gated delta rule

callers.caller: a published model configuration declaring linear-attention layers (the layers that compute the rule)
callers.calls: the op of its graph, one call a layer for a prompt (L tokens) and one a layer a generated token (L = 1)

dimensions.B: 1 and 4, the batches of the serial scan's measured prompt grid
dimensions.L: 1 (a token) and 512 to 16384 (a prompt, the serial scan's measured grid)

callers.caller: the serial scan's measured prompt grid (the measurement the chunked form must beat)
callers.calls: the op at the configuration's head geometry, the inputs at float32 and float16
